issues.description: play.ts shipped with debug console.logs and a relative internal source import
issues.detail: play.ts was switched from `import * as z from 'zod/v4'` to `./packages/zod/src/index.js` and contains scratch console.log debugging. This is a developer scratchpad that breaks for fresh checkouts and pollutes the diff. Revert before merge.

issues.description: Override callback now fires on parent schemas, doubling invocation count (6 -> 12)
issues.detail: Removing the `if (!seen.isParent)` guard around `ctx.override(...)` causes user-supplied overrides to run on every parent chain node. The existing test 'do not run on references' was silently updated from 6 to 12, contradicting its stated intent. This is a user-visible behavior change that needs justification or a changelog entry.

issues.description: JSON.stringify-based deep equality for property dedup is fragile and costly
issues.detail: Both new dedup loops compare via `JSON.stringify(schema[key]) === JSON.stringify(refSeen.def![key])`. This is order-sensitive, fails on undefined/functions/cycles/BigInt, and is O(size) per key on large nested schemas. Use a structural deep-equal or canonicalize before comparing.

issues.description: Non-null assertion on refSeen.def can throw when def is undefined
issues.detail: `key in refSeen.def!` and `refSeen.def![key]` assume def is always populated whenever refSchema.$ref is set, but Seen.def is optional and the parent branch already guards it. Schemas processed via processor-only paths can leave def undefined and crash finalize(). Add the same guard used elsewhere.

issues.description: Parent-only property pruning deletes any key not in the cached child snapshot
issues.detail: The `isParentRef` branch iterates `for (const key in schema)` and deletes anything missing from `_cached`. Processor-added or legitimately inherited child keys (e.g. type/format hoisted from the parent) can be stripped. The interaction with the subsequent `refSchema.$ref` mutation is hard to reason about.

issues.description: z.file() anyOf branches no longer self-describe; shared props hoisted to root
issues.detail: Each anyOf branch previously carried type/contentEncoding/format/minLength/maxLength; now only contentMediaType remains in the branch with the rest at root. Semantically valid under draft 2020-12 but a visible output shape change that may break downstream tools consuming branches standalone. Worth a changelog note and verification under older drafts.

synthesis.summary: The core change — tracking `parent` separately from processor-set `ref` and propagating $refs through wrappers like readonly().meta({id}).describe() — is a real fix backed by a new regression test. However, the PR ships play.ts as a debug scratchpad pointing at internal paths (consensus P0 blocker) and silently changes override semantics so callbacks fire on parent chain nodes (test count doubled 6 -> 12). The finalize() rewrite also relies on JSON.stringify-based deep equality and a non-null assertion on `refSeen.def` that can throw, and aggressively prunes parent-only properties. The z.file() output shape change is user-visible and warrants a changelog note.
